items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: And she was the one that was instructing me, because, see, Gladys had got her schooling from Benny Goodman...

ctx.x: Well, do you want to say it or not? You don't have to.

Well, what happened is -- or what I heard. Now, I don't know (inaudible) and I got this from Hamp and Gladys, that Hamp had cut him off from playing Flying Home, and he turned around on stage and he cussed Hamp (inaudible) he get through when he get ready. So Hamp cut the band in on

him on the outchorus course and went to the B flat (inaudible). And that's where they had the confusion. And so from that point Gladys said, give him his notice. He had told Hamp I couldn't read when he finally said he was getting me in the band. He said I couldn't read. That's what Hamp said. Now, I don't know.
